summary: Strengthen task design readiness without procedural overhead
description: Execute the authorized research/intake in .go/plans/task-design-readiness.md. Reuse architecture decision/dependency/outcome gates. Strengthen author and critic content review; fix explicitly referenced non-accepted decision dependencies being ignored on none/local tasks. No semantic keyword classifier or mandatory extra approval. Preserve unreferenced trivial/research/legacy tasks. Historical intake-only authority is superseded by the user execution request on 2026-09-15.
acceptance: Audit and reuse existing material-decision and outcome-evidence safeguards; document where semantic task readiness belongs and why. No duplicate gating system or mandatory ADR/approval per trivial task.

A substantial task captures observable behavior, accepted/proposed/delegated/unresolved decisions, state/edge cases, boundaries, dependencies and matching evidence. Open material decisions route to research/design or block dependent implementation; routine tuning remains autonomous.

Content review distinguishes semantic readiness from schema validity; cannot pass solely via keywords, length or an unverified self-attestation. Unknown/unreproduced bugs and unresolved requested outcomes cannot be closed as fixed.

Prove paired vague/actionable examples, unresolved vs delegated choices, a research-only task, trivial fix and legacy task; document proportionate behavior and migration compatibility. References and runtime/visual/audio evidence are conditional on relevance.

Deliver the chosen minimal change with local regression tests, grounded same-agent semantic review of paired examples, critic and a verified immutable stack release. Preserve the intake history and record which decisions were implemented.
